reason: When a harness vendor session could no longer be resumed, every later turn in that chat failed the same way forever, because nothing cleared the saved external session id or continued without it: grok 1.0.40 answers session/load for a session it no longer has with -32603 "Path not found." and data.code FS_NOT_FOUND (checked against the installed CLI; the ACP spec code is -32002 Resource not found), a Grok runtime that does not advertise agentCapabilities.loadSession was refused by #495 with a configuration error, Claude Code (2.1.209 bundled with SDK 0.2.118, and 2.1.277) prints "No conversation found with session ID: ..." on stderr and as an error result and exits 1 before answering initialize, which SDK 0.2.118 surfaces only as "Command failed with exit code 1", and codex-cli 0.154.0 answers thread/resume with -32600 "no rollout found for thread id ...". Each adapter now turns exactly those answers into HarnessVendorSessionNotFoundError (the Claude adapter reads the CLI's stderr through the SDK's public stderr callback while resuming and still passes the lines on to Core's stderr); authentication, transport and other errors are re-raised unchanged. stream_turn catches it once for a chat turn: it forks the Nebula session without a vendor session (fork_reason vendor_session_unavailable), rebinds the chat with a harness_session_rollovers entry, inserts the saved conversation before this turn as handoff context after the operator prompt, records a warning diagnostic and a status event (phase vendor_session_recreated, previous_session_id) that the chat's generic harness status line shows, holds the new session's lock, and opens once more; a second failure fails the turn as before. Non-chat turns keep failing, now with reason code session_not_found. tests/v3/test_vendor_session_recreate.py runs the real HarnessRuntimeService and the real adapters (Grok against a scripted ACP agent subprocess, Claude through the real ClaudeSDKClient over a scripted CLI transport, Codex over a scripted app-server connection) across a simulated Core restart: the six recreation scenarios fail on origin/main and the four guard scenarios (auth and internal Grok load errors, a Claude login failure, an archived Codex thread) pass on both. The selected existing node ids cover the Grok loadSession refusal, the Grok, Claude and Codex resume paths, the handoff context and the parallel-session lock path next to the change.
exclusions: Scoped per the CI-scoping rule: test_harnesses.py, test_harness_adapters.py, test_grok_acp_compliance.py, test_claude_harness_turns.py, test_codex_transport.py, test_codex_turn_outcomes.py, test_harness_commands.py, test_harness_connection_state.py, test_harness_provider_subagents.py, test_harness_stopped_turns.py and the harness tests of test_chat_api.py were run locally in full and pass but are not selected. No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through harnesses.py) never resumes a vendor session the vendor has lost; the Python tests drive the adapters and the runtime service directly. No full suites.
